rows.question: How many customers are there in each country?
rows.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers c GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY customer_count DESC

rows.question: How many orders are currently pending or processing?
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_or_processing_orders FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('pending', 'processing')

rows.question: What is the most expensive product and its price?
rows.sql: SELECT name AS product, unit_price AS price FROM products WHERE is_active ORDER BY unit_price DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: How many employees work in each department?
rows.sql: SELECT e.department, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees e GROUP BY e.department ORDER BY employee_count DESC

rows.question: How many products does each top-level category have?
rows.sql: SELECT top.name AS category, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM products p JOIN categories sub ON sub.category_id = p.category_id JOIN categories top ON top.category_id = sub.parent_category_id GROUP BY top.name ORDER BY product_count DESC

rows.question: What was the total revenue in calendar year 2025?
rows.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

rows.question: Which 5 products generated the most revenue in FY2026?
rows.sql: SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date + INTERVAL '9 months') = 2026 GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

rows.question: What is the average delivery time in days for orders shipped from each warehouse?
rows.sql: SELECT w.name AS warehouse_name, ROUND(AVG(o.delivered_date - o.order_date::date), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders o JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = o.warehouse_id WHERE o.delivered_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY w.name ORDER BY avg_delivery_days

rows.question: How many repeat customers do we have?

rows.question: What percentage of orders were returned for customers in each country?
rows.sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'returned') / COUNT(o.order_id), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC

rows.question: How many distinct products are out of stock in at least one warehouse?
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS out_of_stock_products FROM inventory i WHERE i.quantity_on_hand = 0

rows.question: What is the average review rating for each sub-category?

rows.question: What is the average order value for cash on delivery orders compared with UPI orders?
rows.sql: SELECT o.payment_method, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND o.payment_method IN ('cod', 'upi') GROUP BY o.payment_method ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

rows.question: What is the average salary of employees at each warehouse?

rows.question: Which supplier's products have the lowest average review rating?
rows.sql: SELECT s.name AS supplier, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS total_reviews FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name HAVING COUNT(r.review_id) >= 10 ORDER BY avg_rating ASC LIMIT 1

rows.question: What was the gross profit margin percentage in FY2025?
rows.sql: SELECT ROUND(100 * SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - oi.quantity * p.cost_price) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS gross_profit_margin_pct FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date + INTERVAL '9 months') = 2025

rows.question: How many active customers are there in each loyalty tier?

rows.question: Which sales rep handled the most revenue in 2026 so far?

rows.question: Show monthly revenue for 2025 with a running total.

rows.question: What share of 2025 revenue did each top-level category contribute, as a percentage?
rows.sql: WITH cat_rev AS (SELECT top.name AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories sub ON sub.category_id = p.category_id JOIN categories top ON top.category_id = sub.parent_category_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY top.name), total AS (SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM cat_rev) SELECT cr.category, ROUND(cr.revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(100.0 * cr.revenue / t.total_revenue, 2) AS revenue_share_pct FROM cat_rev cr CROSS JOIN total t ORDER BY revenue DESC

rows.question: What share of 2025 revenue did each top-level category contribute, as a percentage?
rows.sql: WITH cat_rev AS (SELECT top.name AS category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories sub ON sub.category_id = p.category_id JOIN categories top ON top.category_id = sub.parent_category_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY top.name), total_rev AS (SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total FROM cat_rev) SELECT c.category, ROUND(c.revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(100.0 * c.revenue / t.total, 2) AS share_pct FROM cat_rev c CROSS JOIN total_rev t ORDER BY c.revenue DESC

rows.question: How many new customers signed up in each fiscal quarter of FY2026?

rows.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM((oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) - (p.cost_price * oi.quantity)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(oi.unit_price * oi.quantity * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 0), 2) AS gross_profit_margin_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')

rows.question: How many active customers are there in each loyalty tier?
rows.sql: SELECT c.loyalty_tier, COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY c.loyalty_tier ORDER BY active_customer_count DESC

rows.question: Which sales rep handled the most revenue in 2026 so far?
rows.sql: SELECT e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS sales_rep_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS total_revenue FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON e.employee_id = o.handled_by JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2027-01-01' AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: Show monthly revenue for 2025 with a running total.
rows.sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) AS monthly_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM')) SELECT month, monthly_revenue, ROUND(SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS running_total FROM monthly_rev ORDER BY month

rows.question: How many customers placed at least one order in each of 2024, 2025 and 2026?
rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025, 2026) GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)) = 3) sub

rows.question: How many employees report to the Head of Operations, directly or indirectly?
rows.sql: WITH RECURSIVE org_chart AS (SELECT employee_id FROM employees WHERE job_title = 'Head of Operations' UNION ALL SELECT e.employee_id FROM employees e JOIN org_chart o ON e.manager_id = o.employee_id) SELECT COUNT(*) - 1 AS employee_count FROM org_chart

rows.question: What share of 2025 revenue did each top-level category contribute, as a percentage?
rows.sql: WITH order_rev AS (SELECT oi.order_id, (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS item_rev FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned')), cat_rev AS (SELECT COALESCE(p_parent.category_id, p_cat.category_id) AS top_category_id, COALESCE(p_parent.name, p_cat.name) AS top_category_name, SUM(orv.item_rev) AS rev FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN categories p_cat ON p.category_id = p_cat.category_id LEFT JOIN categories p_parent ON p_cat.parent_category_id = p_parent.category_id JOIN order_rev orv ON oi.order_id = orv.order_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') GROUP BY COALESCE(p_parent.category_id, p_cat.category_id), COALESCE(p_parent.name, p_cat.name)), total_rev AS (SELECT SUM(rev) AS total FROM cat_rev) SELECT cr.top_category_name, ROUND(cr.rev, 2) AS category_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * cr.rev / tr.total, 2) AS revenue_share_pct FROM cat_rev cr CROSS JOIN total_rev tr ORDER BY revenue_share_pct DESC

rows.question: Which month of 2025 had the highest order cancellation rate, and what was the rate?
rows.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS order_month, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancellation_rate FROM orders o WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY cancellation_rate DESC LIMIT 1

rows.question: How many new customers signed up in each fiscal quarter of FY2026?
rows.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM c.signup_date) AS fiscal_quarter, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS new_customers FROM customers c WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.signup_date) = 2026 GROUP BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM c.signup_date) ORDER BY fiscal_quarter

rows.question: Among products sold in both 2024 and 2025, which 3 had the biggest increase in units sold?
rows.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, (SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END)) AS increase_in_units FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'returned') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY increase_in_units DESC LIMIT 3
